model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the percentage of three different metals—Aluminium, Copper, and Nickel—used in the production of batteries in Germany and the European Union (EU) over three consecutive years: 2021, 2022, and 2023. The vertical axis represents the percentage, ranging from 0 to 30%, and the horizontal axis lists the three metals. In Germany, the percentage of Aluminium used in battery production was 3.6% in 2021, 2.7% in 2022, and 1.0% in 2023. Copper usage was 8.3% in 2021, 11.3% in 2022, and 2.2% in 2023. Nickel usage was 25.1% in 2021, 24.7% in 2022, and 11.4% in 2023. In the EU, Aluminium usage was 3.2% in 2021, 2.8% in 2022, and 1.7% in 2023. Copper usage was 4.4% in 2021, 5.1% in 2022, and 1.3% in 2023. Nickel usage was 24.3% in 2021, 23.3% in 2022, and 14.6% in 2023. The bars are color-coded to represent each year, with 2021 in blue, 2022 in purple, and 2023 in grey. The chart does not include any additional annotations or visual emphasis on specific bars.
